displayName: SailPoint ISC — Privileged or destructive identity change
description: Detects privileged or destructive SailPoint ISC changes (account/identity disable, enable, delete, create, role/source/token mutations) with target account source, authoritative identity source, and full ISC event context.
query:
let NonPersonActors = dynamic(["system", "unknown", "all", "global", "webservice", "mantistaskscheduler", ""]);
SailPointISC_Events
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where IsPrivileged
| extend ActorKey = tolower(Actor), TargetKey = tolower(coalesce(TargetIdentity, Target))
| join kind=leftouter (SailPointISC_IdentityKeys | project ActorKey = JoinKey, ActorUpn = UserPrincipalName, ActorDisplay = DisplayName, ActorIdSource = IdentitySource) on ActorKey
| join kind=leftouter (SailPointISC_IdentityKeys | project TargetKey = JoinKey, TargetUpn = UserPrincipalName, TargetDisplay = DisplayName, TargetIdSource = IdentitySource, TargetAuthSource = AuthoritativeSource) on TargetKey
| extend ResponseSubject = iff(isnotempty(ActorUpn) and ActorKey !in (NonPersonActors), "Actor", "Target")
| extend
    IdentityAuthoritativeSource = coalesce(TargetBracketSource, TargetIdSource, TargetAuthSource, "SailPoint ISC"),
    CleanTargetIdentity = coalesce(TargetDisplay, TargetIdentity, Target, "unknown"),
    UserPrincipalName = iff(ResponseSubject == "Actor", ActorUpn, TargetUpn),
    DisplayName = iff(ResponseSubject == "Actor", ActorDisplay, coalesce(TargetDisplay, TargetIdentity))
| extend
    ResponseAction = iff(ResponseSubject == "Actor", "Open this UPN in Assets > Identities. Revoke sessions. Confirm the user compromised only if the change was unauthorized.", "The actor is not a person. Open the target UPN in Assets > Identities and review the change before revoking sessions."),
    UpnSuffix = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[1]),
    AccountCustomEntity = iff(isnotempty(UserPrincipalName), UserPrincipalName, iff(isnotempty(CleanTargetIdentity) and CleanTargetIdentity != "unknown", CleanTargetIdentity, Actor))
| summarize
    EventCount = count(),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    PrimaryEvent = any(EventName),
    EventNames = strcat_array(make_set(EventName, 5), ", "),
    Operations = strcat_array(make_set(OperationName, 5), ", "),
    Outcomes = strcat_array(make_set(Outcome, 5), ", "),
    AccountSources = strcat_array(make_set(SourceName, 5), ", "),
    TargetAccounts = strcat_array(make_set_if(TargetAccount, isnotempty(TargetAccount) and TargetAccount != "unknown", 5), ", "),
    TriggerInterfaces = strcat_array(make_set_if(TriggerInterface, isnotempty(TriggerInterface), 5), ", "),
    ChangedItems = strcat_array(make_set_if(ChangedItem, isnotempty(ChangedItem), 5), "; "),
    EventDetails = substring(strcat_array(make_set(EventSummary, 5), " | "), 0, 900),
    TrackingIds = strcat_array(make_set_if(TrackingNumber, isnotempty(TrackingNumber), 5), ", ")
    by Actor, TargetIdentity = CleanTargetIdentity, IdentityAuthoritativeSource, UserPrincipalName, DisplayName, ResponseSubject, ResponseAction, UpnSuffix, AccountCustomEntity
| extend
    TargetAccounts = coalesce(TargetAccounts, TargetIdentity),
    TriggerInterfaces = coalesce(TriggerInterfaces, "Direct / System"),
    TrackingIds = coalesce(TrackingIds, "n/a"),
    AlertAction = iff(EventCount == 1, PrimaryEvent, strcat(EventNames, " (", EventCount, " events)")),
    AlertTarget = strcat(
        TargetIdentity,
        iff(isnotempty(TargetAccounts) and tolower(TargetAccounts) != tolower(TargetIdentity), strcat(" [acct: ", TargetAccounts, "]"), ""),
        iff(isnotempty(IdentityAuthoritativeSource) and IdentityAuthoritativeSource != "SailPoint ISC" and IdentityAuthoritativeSource != AccountSources, strcat(" (HR: ", IdentityAuthoritativeSource, ")"), ""))
| where EventCount >= 1
